pr_leads.name: Chiswick Book Festival (partners & sponsors)
pr_leads.why_relevant: W4 festival run by St Michael & All Angels, Bedford Park. Its sponsors page lists local firms with links, and the Community Partners page (https://www.chiswickbookfestival.net/community-partners/) lists local groups. Silver tier is £250+ in cash, goods or services, so K1 could give services (e.g. moving festival kit) instead of cash.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Email admin@chiswickbookfestival.net from Dean at K1 offering in-kind support for 2027 (transporting books, staging and kit between venues on festival weekend) in return for a sponsor listing with a link. The 2026 festival is over, so pitch this for the 2027 programme.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Paid or in-kind (Silver £250+). Dean to approve.

pr_leads.name: Bedford Park Festival (commercial opportunities)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Chiswick's biggest community festival (50+ years). Every partner is listed on the Partners page with logo, contact details and a website link, and named in a leaflet delivered to 3,000+ homes. Its major partner is Savills, the estate agent, so the audience is people about to move.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Email Torin Douglas (torindouglas@gmail.com) with an offer to sponsor a Green Days stand or donate a High Roller Tombola prize, or to provide in-kind help moving marquees and stall kit. Ask for the partner listing with a link. Green Days is in June, so plan for 2027.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: The page quotes £200–£1,000 for partner packages (earlier search showed Silver £300 / Gold £600 / Diamond £1,200). Dean to approve.

pr_leads.name: The Isleworth Society (business membership)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Amenity society for TW7. It welcomes local businesses as corporate members and offers newsletter, event and advert sponsorship. A good fit for the Isleworth area page.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Join as a corporate member (£45 per the search snippet; check before paying), then offer a short 'moving in Old Isleworth: parking and access' tip piece for the newsletter or website, and ask whether members are listed or linked. Contact: membership.isleworth.soc@gmail.com.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Low cost. Dean to approve.

pr_leads.name: West Chiswick & Gunnersbury Society
pr_leads.why_relevant: Residents' society covering exactly the Gunnersbury and West Chiswick streets the new Gunnersbury page targets. Its newsletters cover Gunnersbury station, Brentford stadium and local planning.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Join, then offer something useful such as free moving boxes for a society event, or a practical note on parking suspensions in the Hounslow and Ealing parts of Gunnersbury for the newsletter or site. Ask for a mention with a link. Contact: secretary@westchiswickgs.org.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Membership fee. No link guaranteed: it's a relationship play.

pr_leads.name: Gunnersbury Park & Museum (support / corporate volunteering)
pr_leads.why_relevant: A charity-run park and museum jointly owned by Ealing and Hounslow, right next to K1's Gunnersbury and Chiswick patch. Its Support Us page invites corporate partnerships, from staff volunteering days to naming rights,, and it runs corporate volunteering days (https://www.visitgunnersbury.org/volunteer/corporate-volunteers/).
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Book a K1 team volunteering day or offer in-kind moving help for museum or events kit, then ask whether supporters are credited online. Share photos on K1's Instagram and GBP too. Contact: info@visitgunnersbury.org.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: No published supporters page found, so a link isn't guaranteed. The local PR value is the main win.

pr_leads.name: West London Chambers (of Commerce)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Chamber covering Hounslow, Ealing and Hammersmith & Fulham (it says it has around 2,300 members). Its member listings and Business Awards brochure link to members. Strong for office-removal leads. This is a different organisation from 'West London Business' and the London Chamber, which are already on the list.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Ask about membership and whether the member directory includes a website link. Enter the Business Awards and attend the Festival of Business to meet facilities and office managers. Lead with the new /removals/office/ hub.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Paid membership. Dean to approve.

pr_leads.name: The Chiswick Directory
pr_leads.why_relevant: W4-only business directory with free and premium listings (add a listing at chiswick.directory/add-listing). It's relevant to the 'removals chiswick' target keyword and not in directory-citations.csv or citations-30.csv.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Create a free listing using the exact NAP from leadgen/nap-citation-sheet.md (see NAP rules) · 0330 103 0041) and link to /areas-covered/chiswick-removals/.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Free tier. The box couldn't reach the site from here (timeout), but search confirmed it's live, so check it in a browser before submitting.

pr_leads.name: The Chiswick Herald (Chiswick & Kew Herald) news desk
pr_leads.why_relevant: Local paper website covering Chiswick and Kew. It's separate from The Chiswick Calendar and ChiswickW4.com, which are already on the list.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Pitch a genuine local story, e.g. K1 donating unwanted furniture from moves to a local charity, or a practical 'moving in Chiswick: book your parking suspension 10 working days ahead' piece. Send to newsdesk@chiswickherald.co.uk. Don't send a sales pitch.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Free editorial. Advertising is also available (paid).

pr_leads.name: Association of Relocation Professionals (ARP), Affiliate membership
pr_leads.why_relevant: UK relocation-industry body. Affiliate membership is open to moving companies and includes a standard entry on the ARP website, a free profile in its newsletter and speaking slots. That puts K1 in front of relocation agents who place international and corporate moves.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Apply via 'Join'. It needs nomination by a Full Member or two referees. Use the international hub and Spain, Dubai and Australia pages as proof of capability.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: £120 admin + £600/yr incl. VAT (per ARP page). Paid, so Dean must approve.

pr_leads.name: My Lawyer In Spain (expert removals interviews)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Spanish legal-services blog that publishes Q&A interviews with removals experts on post-Brexit moves to Spain (this one is with Indalo Transport). That's a direct fit for the live /removals-london-to-spain/ page.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Offer Dean (K1 Removals) for a similar Q&A from the London end: inventories, timing a move with residency paperwork, and what to pack versus buy in Spain. Use the site's contact page. Don't offer payment for the link.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: Free editorial. It may already have a removals partner, so offer a different angle (London departures). It returned a Cloudflare 522 to the box on 24 Oct (it was found and indexed via search), so check it in a browser first.

pr_leads.name: The Connexion (France)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Ran a piece on getting help relocating UK to France; its print directory lists UK-France movers
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Pitch expert comment for future relocation articles; directory listing is likely paid

pr_leads.name: Chiswick Business Network (Think Jeannie)
pr_leads.why_relevant: W4 business networking group (Meetup)
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Attend events to meet office managers; relationship rather than a link

pr_leads.name: Barnes Fair (Barnes Community Association)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Barnes's annual summer fair. The fair page names its 2026 sponsors, including a Transport Sponsor slot, and the BCA's Facebook thank-you post credits Alexanders removals (a Chiswick competitor) as a supporter. Directly supports the Barnes page.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Email fairs@barnes-ca.org (address on the fair page) asking about 2027 sponsorship, especially the Transport Sponsor slot, or offering in-kind help moving stalls and staging. Ask for a sponsor listing with a link. Join the 2027 stallholder mailing list via the page.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: paid (tier prices not published; ask)

pr_leads.name: Barnes Common Ltd: corporate volunteering
pr_leads.why_relevant: The charity that manages Barnes Common lists past corporate groups (e.g. M&S Barnes, Radnor House School) on its page. A half-day team session builds a genuine Barnes connection and can lead to a mention in its news or newsletter.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Book a half-day session for the K1 team via the page's contact form, then offer free boxes or help moving kit for its Autumn Fayre or Winter Wassail. Ask whether supporters are credited online. No link is promised.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: paid (page says from £35 per person, minimum £300 + VAT)

pr_leads.name: OSO Arts Centre: Theatre Angels / business support
pr_leads.why_relevant: Theatre and café on Barnes Pond (49 Station Road, SW13), the venue the live Barnes page already mentions. Its Theatre Angels scheme credits supporters in programmes and on a 'Wall of Angels'. It also runs OSO Sorted networking events.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Ask the OSO whether a business can join at Angel level, or sponsor a production in return for a programme and website credit with a link. Attend an OSO Sorted networking evening first to meet the team.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: paid (Cherub £50, Angel £260, Guardian Angel £500 per the page)

pr_leads.name: The Putney Society: shoppers' discount scheme
pr_leads.why_relevant: Amenity society for Putney and Roehampton. Its Independent Trader's Discount Scheme publishes a list of participating local businesses for members. A listing puts K1 in front of SW15 homeowners and could carry a link.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Contact the scheme organiser (vickysw15@aol.com, given on the page) and ask whether a removals company outside SW15 can join by offering members a discount, and whether listings link to websites. Discount terms are Dean's decision.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: unknown (joining terms not published; a member discount would cost K1 margin)

pr_leads.name: Positively Putney BID: associate membership
pr_leads.why_relevant: Putney's BID runs a public business directory and promotes members on its site and social media. Associate membership is offered to businesses just outside the BID area.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Email Nicolagrant@positivelyputney.co.uk (on the page) asking whether K1 is eligible as a non-Putney associate member and what the fee would be, and whether it includes a directory listing with a link.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: paid (fee is a proportion of business rates; amount unknown)

pr_leads.name: Putney.news
pr_leads.why_relevant: Independent SW15 news site that covers council, transport (Hammersmith Bridge, Putney Bridge) and riverside flooding. Expert comment from a removals firm on moving-day parking or tides is a natural fit.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Use the 'Send us a tip or story' form to offer Dean as a source on practical moving-day issues (Wandsworth's 7-working-day suspension rule, riverside tides, Hammersmith Bridge detours). No sales pitch. Any link is the editor's choice.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: free (editorial); advertising available at unknown cost

pr_leads.name: The Wandsworth Society (organisation membership)
pr_leads.why_relevant: Amenity society covering the town centre, Wandsworth Common, Earlsfield and Southfields. It publishes newsletters (Autumn 2026 issue online) and lists local news. A relationship play for the Wandsworth page.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Join as an organisation, then offer a short practical note for the newsletter (e.g. moving-day parking under Wandsworth's rules) or free boxes for a society event. Ask about a mention with a link.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: paid (organisations £30 a year per the page)

pr_leads.name: South West Londoner (SWL)
pr_leads.why_relevant: News site covering south-west London boroughs, including Wandsworth and Richmond. Useful for community stories and expert comment.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Email the news desk (address on the contact page) with a genuine local story, e.g. a K1 community initiative or practical comment on the Wandsworth gyratory consultation's effect on moving day. Keep it news-led.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: free (editorial); advertising cost unknown

pr_leads.name: Australian Times (Blue Sky Publications)
pr_leads.type: Expat news, Australians in the UK
pr_leads.why_relevant: News site for Australians living in the UK, based at Putney Bridge Approach (SW6). Its readers are the people returning home, which supports the live /removals-london-to-australia/ page.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Pitch Dean as an expert source for a feature on shipping household goods from London to Australia (email info@ or editor@australiantimes.co.uk). Its 'Write for us' page says it won't accept content written to place links, so treat it as PR. A link only comes through advertising or the editor's choice.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: free for editorial (no links); advertising cost unknown

pr_leads.name: Eye on Spain: business directory
pr_leads.why_relevant: Long-running forum and directory for British expats in Spain. The page claims 10,000+ daily visitors and 60,000+ members. A directory listing also appears in the forums and supports the live /removals-london-to-spain/ page.
pr_leads.how_to_pitch: Add a listing under removals/relocation with the Spain page URL. Separately, answer moving questions in the forum as K1, within its rules on business posts.
pr_leads.cost_or_caveat: paid (€9 per month per the page, cancel any time)

drafts.name: barnes-removals
drafts.notes: Title "Removals Barnes: Removal and Storage Company SW13 London". About 1,600 words of the shared area template: H2 typo "Moving Services in **SW12**", "over a decade" repeated three times, "Diverse Fleet", "storage solutions in Barnes", "guarantee", "Affordable", "cheaper price for students", a no-charge-for-delays FAQ, and a parking FAQ that says a permit often isn't needed. | Rewritten from scratch around SW13 specifics: Castelnau/Lonsdale Road, The Terrace, Harrods Village, the High Street and pond. Hammersmith Bridge still closed to motor traffic (TfL page, checked 25 Oct). Vine Road level crossings. **Richmond Council suspension rules** (page updated 10 Aug 2026, checked 25 Oct): CPZ bays only, form says 7 working days but the banner says 10, so we use 10; more than 8 bays needs 10 days; whole-day only; signs 3 full days before. Adds move manager, evening/weekend moves and a video survey. Removes all fleet and years claims and "guarantee".

drafts.name: putney-removals
drafts.notes: Same template, title "Removals Putney: Removals And Storage SW15 London", with "for the past ten years", "fleet of vehicles", "guaranteed" and "student prices". | SW15 specifics: High Street/bridge end, West Putney, Putney Wharf, Putney Heath/Roehampton (Alton Estate), Upper Richmond Road. **Wandsworth Council suspension rules** (page updated 11 Mar 2026, checked 25 Oct): 7 clear working days, submission day/weekends/bank holidays excluded, 3pm cut-off, same number of bays every day. No council suspensions on unrestricted streets, and red routes go to TfL. Putney Embankment named in the EA tidal flood alert area. Boat Race listed as a special event. Putney Bridge carries more traffic while Hammersmith Bridge is closed.

drafts.name: wandsworth-removals
drafts.notes: Same template, title "Removals Wandsworth: ... SW18", with "one of the leading removals companies in London", "more than ten years", "fleet" and "guarantee". | SW18 specifics: the Southfields Grid, Earlsfield/Garratt Lane, Wandsworth Common/Toast Rack, Ram Quarter/Southside, Old York Road/riverside. Gyratory (A3/A205): TfL dropped the removal scheme in 2025, and its consultation on bus lanes and crossings closes **Fri 6 Nov 2026** (TfL Have Your Say, checked 25 Oct). Wandsworth rules angled differently from Putney: disabled/car club/EV bays only as a last resort, overnight lorries need permission, enforcement but no promise the bay is clear, Wimbledon Championships listed as a special event (Southfields).
